module "LayerSameName.dsf"

product 0 MaterialLayer "Layers/ML_LiSameName" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="Attrs", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=0) : material @L3:C1 "Attrs"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L14:C27 "Roughness"

  inputs %0
  outputs %3
